# Heritage Design Center

> Kitchen and bath design showroom in Lacey, Washington — serving all of Western Washington. We help homeowners and builders design, select, and supply every material for kitchen and bathroom renovations — all under one roof.

## About

Heritage Design Center is a kitchen and bath design showroom located at 8695 Martin Way E #101, Lacey, WA 98516. We serve homeowners, contractors, and builders throughout all of Western Washington — including Seattle, Tacoma, Bellevue, Olympia, Puyallup, Gig Harbor, Centralia, Chehalis, and the greater Puget Sound region.

Our showroom is a hands-on design space where clients can see and touch full cabinet displays, stone slabs, tile walls, and hardware in every finish before making decisions. Our on-site designers guide clients from concept through material selection to final delivery.

## What We Do

- Kitchen design and material supply
- Bathroom design and material supply
- Free design consultations (30–60 minutes, no commitment)
- Full project coordination — one partner for design and all materials
- Direct job-site delivery of cabinetry, countertops, tile, and fixtures

## Materials & Collections

- **Cabinetry** — Stock to fully custom; plywood construction, soft-close hardware, hundreds of door styles. Brands: KCD Kitchen Cabinet Distributors, Lectus Cabinetry, Merit Cabinetry, Showplace Cabinetry
- **Countertops** — Quartz, marble, quartzite, granite, and butcher block. Brands: MSI Surfaces, Cambria, Caesarstone, Vicostone, Jaaron Wood Countertops
- **Tile & Stone** — Floor, wall, backsplash, and shower tile in every style
- **Bath Collection** — Vanities, tubs, showers, and fixtures for complete bathroom renovations
- **Hardware & Fixtures** — Pulls, knobs, faucets, and lighting. Brands: Top Knobs, Jeffrey Alexander Hardware
- **Design Services** — Expert guidance from concept to installation

## Our Process

1. **Book a Free Consultation** — 30–60 min, free, no commitment
2. **Showroom Visit & Design** — Tour the showroom, select materials, finalize the design plan
3. **Order & Coordinate** — We handle all ordering and logistics
4. **Delivery** — Direct job-site delivery; typical window 4–6 weeks
